correctness.rationale: Every one of 65,536 vertex masks passed two exact independent cycle predicates; face vector and Euler characteristic matched. A deterministic 25,483-pair matching has 31 critical faces and an exhaustive 375,056-edge oriented-Hasse acyclicity certificate. The signed integer Morse differential from 26 nine-cells to one eight-cell contains seven +1 entries; the 26-by-4 ten-to-nine differential is exactly zero. A unit 8/9-cell cancellation and the Hurewicz classification of ten-cell attaching maps on a wedge of nine-spheres prove the complete integral homotopy. Full independent mod-two boundary ranks agree in every dimension.

value.rationale: The object is the natural terminal vertex-induced forest complex of a canonical sixteen-vertex symmetric cubic graph, beyond elementary cactus/forest families. The precise mixed-dimensional integral wedge with twenty-five ninth-dimensional and four tenth-dimensional spheres supplies a complete new topological classification and a direct exact attaching-map certificate. The pair of Betti ranks and homotopy type are not obtainable from face counts, the Euler characteristic or unrelated graph complexes.
